citationText: 5. Soviet director Sergei Eisenstein entered the debates over screen shape on the side of the “squares,” addressing the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences on September 17, 1930. Rejecting proposals for wider aspect ratios, Eisenstein presented a theoretical argument for the adoption of the 1:1 aspect ratio, which he referred to as “the dynamic square.” See his “The Dynamic Square” in Film Essays and a Lecture , ed. Leyda Jay ( Princeton : Princeton University Press , 1982 ), 48 – 65 .
